hypothesis: C137free states demonstrate representability of these16sampled maps. Intermediate native-state supervision may ease end-to-end inversion; it does not add new input information.
target: Fixed C137states learned from FIT labels only
auxiliary: Squared log-state errors weighted by each state contribution to valid training receivers; masks affect loss weights only
no_expansion: First compare small-set fitting. No full-data training merely because oracle error is low.
limits: Inverse states need not be unique or physical.
Oracle low error does not show that terrain/TX determines those states.
Small-set fitting improvement would not prove generalization.
